population: Union of exact location IDs in canonical DAM data over all requested dates. Retain every ID for every year and requested month, including external locations, reference hubs and dates without a price.
node_identity: Exact official ID, reported name, flags and effective-dated memberships. Preserve source snapshots and named classifications. Price history determines observed availability. Join metadata on the left and retain unknown classifications.
product: CAISO OASIS PRC_LMP v12 DAM, one-hour total prices and published components in USD/MWh. Preserve every original ZIP and source field. Remove exact duplicates and quarantine differing values without a verified revision precedence.
mapping: Named hubs and exact effective hub members are direct. Infer a zone only from coherent CAISO internal path regions or a complete single-zone set of nonzero published LDF members. Disagreement blocks the zonal estimate. Exact effective evidence and code version accompany inferred spans. External evidence must be affirmative.
model: Fixed NSRDB typical meteorological year. Two equally weighted PVWatts v8 locations per zone; normalize hourly AC MW by the 100 MW AC equivalent at each location before mixing. All six sites and model assumptions in config.json.
calendar: UTC interval starts for joins; Pacific midnight-to-midnight delivery and offset labels. Fixed UTC-08 for solar resource local-standard hour. Leap day averages Feb 28 and Mar 1 at the same local-standard hour.
primary: 2024 and 2025 full years; 2026 through Nov 18 inclusive. Retain published prices, inclusive of zero, negative and extreme observations. Compute ratios over observed matched weight only when full-period applicable weights can be determined.
sensitivities: January 1 through November 18 for each year
Balanced nonreference panel with unchanged single zone, complete mapping and at least 90 percent solar and hour coverage in all three matched periods
Only when statistical repairs were applied: exclude affected timestamps from matched support and recalculate
gap_exposure: Count every expected hour. Report known missing-price weight-hours using applicable time-varying zone assignments, and counts of unknown-weight hours separately. Month-split gaps retain a run ID and full start/end. Clustering uses published daily batch and calendar, dated node classification/market area/zone, and Pacific hour.

repair.holdout: Recover original model output first. If original recovery fails, separately mask one- and two-hour blocks within observed site TMY, stratified by season, daylight level, sunrise/sunset and ramps. Use disjoint weeks for tuning and evaluation; calculate holdout effects on matched node and hub prices with observed CAISO prices. Retrospective treatment only. No hourly price repairs.
candidates: linear interpolation between valid adjacent hours
same local-standard hour from adjacent calendar days
repair.decision: These are project guardrails, selected to limit mean hourly error to 2% of AC capacity and cap money-metric effects at ten cents/MWh. Apply every applicable test to held-out blocks resembling the actual gap, never infer nighttime zero from missingness. Human review required where support is insufficient. If no eligible validated repair exists, preserve original missing value and block affected weighted results. No composite share renormalization.

reconciliation.price_total: Use the official total even if the separately published components do not reconcile. Block attribution of a materially unreconciled component decomposition and disclose the residual.
reconciliation.basis: Use common valid node and hub prices and the node's zone weights. Compare total basis with the differences in published component values on the same support; never relabel total basis as congestion.

completion: Require 35 validated market/evidence month receipts; a single verified historical inventory; three distinct verified zonal profiles; complete per-year calendar scaffolds; flagged blocked results; exhaustive key, axis, dictionary, display and checksum checks; sampled source/formula readback; exactly three verified annual Excel files. Report stages independently.

layers.raw: Original OASIS ZIPs and six original model responses
layers.canonical: Dated normalized prices, hourly component values and canonical keys
layers.quality_assessed: Time-varying mapping and validity, hourly flags and gap register
layers.repaired: Optional explicitly accepted model repairs stored apart from original model outputs; zero events yields an empty log
layers.analytical: Additive metrics, matched samples, balanced panel and component differences
layers.delivery: Sealed annual workbooks, readback receipts and publication manifest

change_log.reason: User added study design, gap diagnostics, component basis attribution, balanced panel and repair protocol after official source downloads began and before production annual calculations. Existing frozen price, solar, calendar and cutoff configuration retained. Earlier internal two-day exporter tests used the baseline specification.
change_log.affects: Quality-assessed, analytical, delivery and reporting layers; existing raw market downloads and solar responses remain reusable.
